verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents deep crawling (BFS) with --deep-crawl and --max-pages flags, crash recovery via resume_state/on_state_change for long-running crawls, and adaptive crawling that determines when enough info is gathered, all with a single CLI/API call. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of full-site crawl completeness/reliability at scale, and clearer first-party docs example showing full multi-page crawl output (not just single-URL arun call).
